title: Nemys: World Database of Nematodes
description: Nemys offers documentation on free-living marine, brackish, fresh-water and terrestrial nematodes, mainly providing taxonomic information but also ecological information. Nemys is integrated into the World Register of Marine Species (WoRMS). Data are contributing to the Catalogue of Life via the WoRMS, hosted by the Flanders Marine Institute (VLIZ).
